title: The Effect of Urolithin A (Mitopure®) Supplementation on Muscle Strength in Healthy Middle-Aged Adults

sections.abstract: This is a randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled, parallel study to assess the effects of Urolithin A (Mitopure®) supplementation on muscle strength and performance in healthy middle-aged adults. Participants will be randomized to consume Mitopure® (500 mg), Mitopure® (1000 mg), or placebo once daily for 6 months.
